_comment: Hand-maintained hooks for RuneLite 1.12.33 that are absent from the public canonical mappings.
Merged via: generateVersionPackage --merge mappings/canonical/supplemental-1.12.33.json
Every entry below was recovered from injected-client-1.12.33.jar bytecode, not inferred by name.
Provenance of each obfuscated name:
username                          client.getUsername()      -> GETSTATIC bx.bk
password                          client.setPassword(S)     -> PUTSTATIC bx.bw
otp                               client.setOtp(S)          -> PUTSTATIC ay.cf
loginIndex                        client.getLoginIndex()    -> GETSTATIC bx.cr, imul -505223025
displayName / JX_DISPLAY_NAME     client.init() JX_DISPLAY_NAME  -> PUTSTATIC bx.cl
characterId / JX_CHARACTER_ID     client.init() JX_CHARACTER_ID  -> PUTSTATIC lo.lx
sessionId                         client.init() JX_SESSION_ID    -> PUTSTATIC et.ln
isMenuOpen                        client.isMenuOpen()       -> GETSTATIC client.nu
widgets                           client.di(II)             -> GETSTATIC xz.ch, then GETFIELD ll.ap
Widgets.Widget_interfaceComponents  same site               -> ll.ap:[[Llp; (us extends ll)
KeyHandler_instance               client.getKeyboardIdleTicks() -> GETSTATIC tj.rj:Ltg;
KeyHandler.idleTicks              tg.wo() -> GETFIELD tg.ax, imul 588807121
loginMode                         client.<clinit> / bx.bu login handler -> PUTSTATIC client.da:Lzd;
normalLoginMode                   client.<clinit> initialises client.da from zd.ag (legacyType)
oAuthLoginMode                    login handler reads zd.af (jagexType)
Scene.selectedX / selectedY       eb.bu / eb.bk. The client keeps TWO coordinate pairs and
dp.getSelectedSceneTile() picks between them on isMenuOpen:
the true branch reads eb.bu / eb.bk, the false branch reads
eb.cv / eb.dx. Solace WRITES these to inject a walk target,
and a menu action is processed while the menu is open, so the
menu-open pair (bu/bk) is the one that must be written. The
cv/dx pair is the pointer-hovered value, recomputed from the
mouse every frame - writing it is silently discarded.
Confirmed live: writing eb.bu/eb.bk moved the character;
writing eb.cv/eb.dx produced no movement at all. X vs Y comes
from the tiles array index order, eb.yj[plane][x][y].
Neither pair is garbage-encoded.
CORRECTION: an earlier revision of this file mapped selectedX
/selectedY to eb.cv / eb.dx. That was the hovered pair - the
right fields for READING the tile under the cursor, the wrong
ones for Solace, which only ever writes them. Third-party hook
sets name the menu-open pair as setSelectedSceneTileX/Y, and
the same distinction holds at revisions 223/224/225/227/229.
Scene.viewportWalking             eb.bw, and Scene.checkClick eb.dk. Identified by the client's
own pending-walk test, which reads viewportWalking in the same
expression as a selectedX-against-(-1) comparison (visible as
'viewportWalking && Scene_selectedX != -1' in a semantically
named decompilation). checkClick is the other boolean written
by the same selection-reset routine. This structural rule
scores 5/5 on revisions 223-229 against third-party labels.
CORRECTION: a statistical tiebreak (lowest get/put ratio)
previously assigned viewportWalking to eb.dk. That heuristic
swaps the two on several revisions and is not reliable.
TileItem.worldViewId              dj.ot. The world view stamps its own getId() straight onto
each item: client.ad calls dp.getId() and stores the result
into dj.ot. dp is the WorldView implementation and getId() is
public RuneLite API, so this is anchored on unrenameable names.
Actor.pathLength                  client.np reads du.cc alongside the du.dg[] / du.du[] path
arrays; exact decoder from `getfield du.cc:I; ldc 1538626549;
imul`. Live: 0 while idle, 2 then 1 while walking a short path.
GARBAGE CORRECTIONS (getter multipliers). CanonicalMappingConverter picks
`setter != null ? setter : getter`, but ReflField needs the GETTER: getValue multiplies by the
stored constant, and setValue multiplies by its modular inverse. Shipping the setter therefore
breaks reads AND writes. Five entries were affected: MouseHandler_x, MouseHandler_y,
MouseHandler_idleCycles, MouseHandler_lastPressedTimeMillis, mouseLastPressedTimeMillis.
Proven live: with the synthetic pointer dispatched to (320,211), (260,150) and (400,240),
sw.as * 1924109177 and sw.ax * 378379891 reproduced those exact coordinates, while the shipped
values (363237937 / -524263433) did not. The canonical setters are not even true modular
inverses of the getters here (product != 1), so they are stale rather than merely mis-selected.
MouseHandler_lastPressedTimeMillis: the canonical mappings point this at sw.ap, which is the
wrong field - sw.ap is the last mouse MOVE time. Proven by injecting input into a live client:
after a pointer move with no click, sw.ap updated to 1.2s ago while sw.av stayed 968s stale;
after a click, sw.av updated too. So sw.av is last-pressed and sw.ap is last-moved. The Kraken
hooks.json (same revision - its packetWriter=dw, buffer=xm/xv, Buffer.offset multiplier
-1278253407 all match this client exactly) independently names sw.av as the last-pressed field
with multiplier 4865206394403847849, which decodes to a correct wall-clock timestamp here.
Neither hook is referenced by Solace code today, so this is latent rather than active.
mouseLastPressedTimeMillis (client.gx) is deliberately NOT overridden. An earlier attempt used
-996349481466239501, which is wrong: that constant is the field's own stored value, picked up
from a constant store rather than a decode multiplier, and it does not yield a timestamp. Its
true getter is still unknown, so the canonical value is left in place.
UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES - deliberately not mapped, recorded so the next pass can start here.
Derived by cross-referencing the Storm S2 June 2024 hooks.json (revision 223, 304 named
classes / 2147 named fields) whose obfuscated names do NOT transfer directly to 1.12.33:
worldSelectOpen    -> probably bx.do:Z. At rev 223 this was Login.dn, and Login there also
held loginIndex; here loginIndex/username/password are all on bx, so
Login == bx. Of bx's four static booleans only bx.do has a matching
usage profile (9 gets/18 puts vs a scaled expectation of ~6/18; the
others are 13, 4 and 4 puts), and it is touched by the login handler.
checkClick         -> one of eb.yp / eb.bw / eb.dk (Scene instance booleans; eb.zd is
Scene.isInstance and eb.an is written only in the constructor).
viewportWalking    -> likewise; scaled usage favours eb.bw for checkClick and eb.dk for
viewportWalking, which CONTRADICTS an earlier eb.yp guess. Writing
each candidate false did not stop hover tracking, because the client
re-sets these flags every frame, so the write test was inconclusive.
clickedWidget      -> not satisfiable as a static here. At rev 223 it was a static Widget on
client; in 1.12.33 the only two Llp; statics are the script active/dot
widgets, and the dragged widget is the instance field uw.af, reached
via xz.ch -> us.an. ClientImpl.setDraggedWidget needs a code change,
not a mapping.
TileItem.worldViewId -> rev 223 has Scene.worldViewId and MenuAction.worldViewId but no
TileItem.worldViewId, so this hook postdates that mapping set.
lastButton, loginResponse1-3, password -> absent from the Storm hooks.json entirely.
CAUTION: a runtime scan that used MenuEntry param0/param1 as the oracle for these two
reported eb.cu / eb.bx across 5 consecutive samples. That was a FALSE POSITIVE - walk-here
params are canvas pixel coords (366,173 vs decoded MouseHandler x/y 370,177), not scene
coords, so it was matching the click position rather than the selected tile. Do not use
MenuEntry params as a scene-coordinate oracle.
NOTE: JX_DISPLAY_NAME and JX_CHARACTER_ID override incorrect entries in the canonical
mappings, which had them swapped onto lo.lx and bx.bk. bx.bk is in fact `username`.
NOTE: garbage values here are the GETTER (decode) multipliers. ReflField.getValue()
multiplies by the stored value and setValue() multiplies by its modular inverse, so the
getter constant is the correct one. CanonicalMappingConverter prefers `setter`, which for
sw.as disagrees with the bytecode (canonical setter=363237937 vs actual getter=1924109177).
menuAction                        ek.fu, garbage -1612500198. RuneLite's own public
client.menuAction(...) pushes that constant and forwards
straight to ek.fu, so both the target and its junk value
come from an unrenameable call site. Note the same
constant already appears in the canonical mappings as the
garbage for 'doAction', which looks like the same client
function under a second name.
